implementationNotes: The production controller defines algorithm weights, but combineAlgorithmResults currently ranks normal results with an unweighted jaccard + tfidf + sbert combinedScore.
When SBERT succeeds, the production response overallRisk is classified from the maximum SBERT score.
When SBERT is unavailable, the production partial_success response overallRisk is classified from the maximum lexical score across Jaccard and TF-IDF.
This evaluation mirrors the current implementation behavior and does not modify production scoring, thresholds, SBERT fallback, imports, API responses, or frontend behavior.

dataset.description: Controlled topic-pair evaluation dataset for undergraduate research topic similarity.

notes: Cases are controlled topic-pair examples maintained in the repository.
Expected classes are manual pilot labels and must not be represented as final departmental or expert ground truth.

offlineFallbackPolicyEvaluation.description: Applies the current production fallback policy offline to all valid pilot cases. This is not evidence that runtime fallback was triggered.

cases.rationale: Near-duplicate wording with same population, location, and focus.
Low lexical overlap but similar meaning.
Same disease and focus but different population.
Same title pattern but different study location.
Same population and location but different topic focus.
High lexical overlap but different study focus.
Fragmented imported/submitted title should still match the full version.
Same population and location but different health outcome.
Similar intervention but different population and location.
Potential current-session documentation gap with paraphrased wording.
Similar wording but different object of study.

limitations: The dataset is a manually constructed pilot benchmark and is not final department or lecturer-reviewed ground truth.
The dataset is insufficient for final effectiveness claims.
Pairwise title evaluation is not identical to the full API tiered comparison workflow against all database topics.
SBERT metrics only use cases where the local SBERT service returned a valid numeric embedding-derived score.
Operational fallback metrics remain separate and are marked NOT_EVALUATED when no runtime fallback cases occur.
Offline fallback-policy metrics are counterfactual and must not be described as observed runtime fallback.
No production similarity scoring, thresholds, imports, database schema, API response shape, or frontend behavior is changed by this evaluation.
